Painted detailed cinematic high-quality game art consistent with industrial/alien stages; coherent small-scale weathering, strong readable silhouettes, pale green-grey atmosphere. NO characters, NO Engineer, NO Ahab, NO creatures, NO moving dust cloud or animated prop, NO tents, NO identifiable corpses, NO close props embedded. Those will be separate actors.
